name: Everfrozen Earth
desc:
The frozen soil in Snezhnaya's north is home to Morepesok, the only port city on the northern coast. One of the more famous features of this place is the birches that grow here.

During humanity's pioneering era in Snezhnaya, its early residents hewed out a forestry industry that endures and operates to this day.

customize.text: Chronicles of the Land of Snow: A Civilization Tempered by the Cold

<color=#ffd680>August 2, 2026</color>
This is a land where wind and snow never cease, and it is this very frozen expanse that forged the nation known as Snezhnaya.
Tempered by the bitter cold, this nation has never ceased to fight against fate.

<color=#ffd680>August 12, 2026</color>
You've battled dragons and sea monsters, defeated creations of the gods, and faced prophecies of doom and the threat of the Abyss. You've even made it all the way to the moon.
Now, howling winds and relentless snow beckon you toward a new nation, where new encounters and new adventures await... Welcome to Snezhnaya — Everwinter Without Mercy.

<color=#ffd680>August 15, 2026</color>
Here, we have with us a copy of "Bring Out the Kvass!" — supposedly the best-selling newspaper in all of Snezhnaya. Let's take a closer look!

<color=#ffd680>August 19, 2026</color>
Through some exciting, and sometimes even hair-raising, moments, you've met new companions and faced new kinds of battles across the frozen plains of Snezhnaya.
Now, it's time to take your journey further by learning more about your companions and honing your shooting skills!

customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Podvorye Smoked Sausage.

customize.name: Frostfairy Flower
customize.desc: A sacred flower that blooms no matter how harsh the wind and snow. It always radiates a faint, mesmerizing glow that draws the hearts of all who see it.

customize.name: Golden Fern
customize.desc: A fern whose edges radiate a faint golden shimmer. It is said to take on a remarkably unique flavor when stewed.

customize.name: Red Beet
customize.desc: A hardy herbaceous plant capable of thriving even in frozen soil. To survive such an unforgiving environment, it develops a thick, succulent root.

customize.name: Glaciafruit
customize.desc: A star-shaped fruit born from Prime Ice that has undergone a peculiar transformation in the permafrost. Once the branch it grows upon is removed, the fruit falls naturally onto the snow.

customize.name: Snowball Flower
customize.desc: A charming flower with a spherical cluster of petals. When snow settles upon it, the entire bloom looks just like a tiny snowball.

customize.name: Rimecurrant
customize.desc: A richly flavored berry that sprouts from frost-rimed, icy branches.

customize.name: Lumifluorite
customize.desc: A strange fluorite formed under the influence of the powers of the Shadow Realm.

customize.name: Unscorched Blossom Branch
customize.desc:
A blossom branch taken from a monster created by someone to serve their selfish desires. It won't wither or burn in flame.
Before the gloomy alchemist found a way to grant life eternity and put it into practice, he once ran his hand gently over the body of his creation — a monster whose leaves resembled crimson feathers. He imagined the day the undying creature greeting the friend he had awaited for so long from within the flames. And by then... perhaps he should pluck a flower from his creation's body as a gift to mark that friend's escape from the realm of shadows.

customize.name: Eye of Graeae
customize.desc:
A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.

It offers many convenient functions, such as recording blueprints for Prime Ice constructs, creating Prime Ice, calling trains.

...Perhaps it was built for the very purpose of providing all these conveniences.

customize.name: Cryo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
Many treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.

customize.name: Cryoculus
customize.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Cryo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

customize.name: Shadow Wingdrop
customize.desc: A strange, liquefied substance left behind by a creature born within the Shadow Realm.

customize.name: Remnant Incense Guide - Everfrozen Earth
customize.desc:
Gathering three pieces of the Remnant Incense Guide - Everfrozen Earth allows you to unseal the vault of Shadow Realm at the Everfrozen Earth.
Legend has it that early squads exploring the Shadow Realm would occasionally find themselves unable to retrieve the treasures they discovered. In such cases, they would leave a specific "scent trail" behind. Only by piecing together the incense trail can one track down the locations of these long-lost relics.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 189
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Immortal Construct
customize.desc:
A byproduct created by the alchemist Koshchei during his creation of the individual known as the Firebird.
Perhaps this was the gloomy alchemist's habit: whenever one experimental subject from a batch succeeded, all the others would be abandoned or disposed of as he pleased.
This derivative creation should have fused with some form of power and reached completion. Now, however, it can only wander endlessly through the mountain gorges as an incomplete, mindless beast.

customize.name: Furiosa
customize.desc: A Volkodlak archer who once nearly lost her life. After undergoing alchemical modification, her body's strength surpassed the limits of living beings, and she gained a measure of authority over trees. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a life-form beyond time, one closer to eternity. But at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path. And so, she remains in a state as though her body has been parasitized by trees.

customize.name: Bandersnatch
customize.desc: A product of bio-alchemy, once flourished in Snezhnaya. Back then, the elements of all life were countless puzzle pieces scattered across the ground, and the researchers who experimented with them pieced them together as they pleased. Most of their creations, however, violated the laws of the world and perished in failure. Lurking in the dark, fixing its vacant gaze upon its prey as it moves through rock, earth, ice, and snow, this monster may be the most cunning of those that still remain in the world today.

customize.name: Volkodlak Lobber
customize.desc:
A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, their powerful upper bodies allow them to throw with greater force and precision. Volkodlak may not excel at shaping Prime Ice or wielding elemental power, but among the many fae lineages, few can match their command over physical strength.

customize.name: Volkodlak Basher
customize.desc:
A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, they possess a feral instinct for bringing their own power to bear. Should an untrained human face such a Volkodlak with weapons in hand, victory would undoubtedly belong to the latter.

customize.name: Volkodlak Raider
customize.desc:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With their swift movements and senses keener than a human's, they can evade many attacks in battle by instinct alone, making them quite troublesome opponents in close-quarters combat.

customize.name: Volkodlak Sharpshooter
customize.desc:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
They possess senses keener than those of humans. Whether in their perception of wind speed or their vision under certain conditions, these traits give them unique advantages, allowing them to achieve far greater accuracy than ordinary people when firing bows, crossbows, or cannons from long range.

customize.name: Leomastiff Guard
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak of the canine clans that usually appears somewhat lazy.
Among the many Volkodlak clans, the canine clans have always enjoyed a better reputation. Loyal, friendly, and usually mild-mannered. Though they will turn ferocious when those they have sworn to serve, or friends they know well, are placed in danger, striking down anyone they deem enemies.
It is said that during a war long ago, their clan fought His Majesty the Tsar to the last in defense of their own king, and for this, earned His Majesty's favor.

customize.name: Long-Eared Striker
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak that usually conceals its slender body beneath a cloak and moves in secrecy.
It is said that long ago, the artisans of the Golden City, who held the authority of creation, fashioned bodies for fae for many different purposes. This type of Volkodlak was originally created to test the limits of reproductive capability.
Yet after the calamity that reduced that golden realm to ruins, the long-eared clan survived to the present day thanks to their great numbers.
Now, they are masters of their own bodies. Agile enough to move deftly even across snow, they have become a threat that those crossing the snowy plains must handle with care.

customize.name: Channel Contact
customize.desc:
A cunning Volkodlak that disguises its hand cannon as a tree trunk.
Skilled at disguising the weapons and cargo they carry, they are often entrusted with transporting goods or relaying intelligence.
The hand cannon they carry was likely something they made in their spare time. At times, they also use it to fire signal rounds disguised as fireworks.
Don't be fooled by their appearance. These fae are far more shrewd and cunning than they seem.

customize.name: Fanged Zealot
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.
Among the many different Volkodlaks, those resembling giant elephants or mammoths possess some of the noblest bloodlines. Their clan once produced many formidable war leaders, many of whom even served as close retainers to the King of Beasts.
Yet the greater an individual fae's power and the longer its life, the harder it becomes for such beings to form a clan. Compared with other Volkodlaks, this type is now far rarer in Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Voywolf Hunter
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.
Their clan once prospered to the point that they could serve as an independent army under the King of Beasts. Yet after the Belyi Tsar, master of the Pale Star's royal court, unified the frozen lands, the clan's relatively small losses in the war caused them to fall under suspicion. They gradually declined, and by the time the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, they had withdrawn from the center of power in Snezhnaya. Today, most wolf-pack Volkodlak make their homes in the snowy plains and mountain forests.

customize.name: Winged Halberd-Knight
customize.desc:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
Records show that in the century after the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, the Vila went through many turbulent periods. Among them were fae who launched small-scale rebellions out of dissatisfaction with the Tsaritsa's policies toward the fae nobility.
The rebellions were soon suppressed, but the fact that their leaders were descendants of the old Vila nobility once led to a major split within the Vila people.

customize.name: Winged Soarer Knight
customize.desc:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
It's said that the Vila were among the fae clans that followed the Belyi Tsar from the very beginning of his campaign to unify the frozen lands. Their ability to take brief flight gives them exceptional mobility, allowing them to scout enemy formations and carry out long-distance raids with ease.
Most members of the Druzhna, the personal guard founded during the Belyi Tsar reign, were Vila.

customize.name: Chimeric Armored Beast
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a four-legged beast were given a carapace and charging horn like those of an Onikabuto, it might well become a shock force capable of breaking through enemy formations.
In theory, man-made monsters designed around a single function rarely survive in the wild. Once they lose the place or purpose for which they were made, most perish for having defied the laws of nature. Clearly, however, the Armored Beast is not one of them.
Today, on the frozen lands of Snezhnaya, Armored Beasts can often be seen hunting in packs.

customize.name: Chimeric Burrowbeast
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a monster that burrows and moves through earth and snow were granted vision that could see all within the shadows, could it become an even stronger predator?
The experiment proved astonishingly successful. These Burrowbeasts move beneath the surface at night, digging traps in the dark or hiding in the shadows to hunt.
According to a report in Vestnik, a worker living in Svetloledovka once saw a giant Burrowbeast nearly as tall as two people... though that is probably nothing more than a wild rumor.

customize.name: Chimeric Winged Elephant
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
A short-legged elephant with wings could likely migrate without being restricted by terrain, and would also be able to reach fruit growing in higher places.
For that purpose alone, its creator brought such a beast into being. Later, during the war against the dark tide, Chimeric Winged Elephants worked alongside the Vila in intelligence and communications, ensuring that the Belyi Tsar's commands could pass smoothly and swiftly as his army advanced.

customize.name: Chimeric Horned Bear
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy, a man-made monster with an exceptionally unusual formation.
A man-made monster not formed according to its creator's design, but through the spontaneous assembly of life segments. As a result, it came to possess certain wondrous traits, including the ability to freely wield elemental power.
Even if life is broken down until almost nothing remains but segments, could some will or power still guide them to grow according to a mysterious plan?
Perhaps no one knows the answer to that by now.

customize.name: Rugged Elder Leshy
customize.desc:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
With only fragmentary sentience and no ability to speak, Leshies may appear to be the result of the Golden Realm's early experiments. Yet according to records, the truth is the opposite. Only after its artisans had almost fully mastered the authority over life did they create this race of fae.
Perhaps there is some true purpose within this that neither the fae nor humans of the present can fully understand.

customize.name: Juvenile Tree Segment
customize.desc:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
Among the many fae of Snezhnaya, Leshies are a very unusual kind, rarely appearing in cities. They may well be the longest-lived among all fae, and few members of other long-lived races have ever witnessed a Leshy's life from beginning to end. Of course, most people would likely struggle even to distinguish one Leshy from another.

customize.name: Snow Poplar Wood
customize.desc: Wood from Snow Poplars that have smooth surfaces and light, soft textures. A fine choice for making all sorts of small woodworking products...

customize.name: White Birch Wood
customize.desc: Wood from White Birches that boasts high density and toughness. Used for building structures for which bending resistance is a necessity...

customize.name: Larch Wood
customize.desc: Wood from Larches. They possess considerable hardness and are highly corrosion-proof. Snezhnayans often use it to build pillars and boards.

customize.name: Kuzmichev
customize.desc: The meticulous owner of "Kuznets". As a weapons enthusiast and stickler for detail, he's confident that no one can find any weapons better than his in all of Snezhnograd.

customize.name: Zyryanov
customize.desc: The owner of Kvasnik. Alongside selling tasty and affordable drinks, he's an avid innovator of a variety of ice creams, regularly providing free samples to anyone willing.

customize.name: Grigory
customize.desc: The kindhearted owner of Bratskaya. At the risk of harming business, he frequently helps struggling customers, often nearby residents, by giving favors to them under the pretense of selling on credit.

customize.name: Buturlina
customize.desc: A server at Podvoyre Restaurant. She stands by every dish on the menu and despite the house rules saying otherwise, may even be willing to help with reservations.

customize.name: Blyushko
customize.desc: The owner of Sadov-Arbat, a well respected establishment famous throughout Snezhnaya that even receives orders from the palace. Rather than prioritizing being an approachable salesman at the risk of damaging goods, he instead prides himself on his business wares for both their beauty and fragility.

customize.name: Moes
customize.desc: The owner of Torchlight Books. He has passionately studied over the years how history and geography intertwine to create a timeline of significant geological and hydrological formations across Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Tsaritsa
customize.desc: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya, known as Vassaga, is the Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Pierro
customize.desc: The first Fatuus, also known as The Jester. He was a royal mage in Khaenri'ah and was cursed with immortality. His real name is Eftirvit.

customize.name: Il Capitano
customize.desc: The First of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and the Sentinel Knight of Khaenri'ah. His real name is Thrain.

customize.name: Il Dottore
customize.desc: The Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, codenamed The Doctor. Had multiple "segments" of himself, nearly all of which he destroyed in a deal with the Dendro Archon. His real name is Zandik.

customize.name: Columbina
customize.desc: The Trilune Goddess and the former Third of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as Damselette. Her real name is Columbina Hyposelenia.

customize.name: Arlecchino
customize.desc: The Fourth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as The Knave. Her real name is Peruere.

customize.name: Pulcinella
customize.desc: The Fifth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as The Rooster. He is the mayor of Snezhnograd and Glupov and the Speaker of the Snezhnograd Veche. His real name is Mirko Radovidovich Veleshek.

customize.name: Sandrone
customize.desc: The Seventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, codenamed Marionette. Her real name is Marionette Guillotin.

customize.name: La Signora
customize.desc: The Eighth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, also known as The Fair Lady. Her real name is Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter.

customize.name: Pantalone
customize.desc: The Ninth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as Regrator. He is in charge of Snezhnaya's economic policies. His real name is Feofan Sergeyevich Veksel.

customize.name: Tartaglia
customize.desc: The Eleventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as Childe. His real name is Ajax.

customize.name: Celaeno
customize.desc: An Augury Bird from Snezhnaya and Linnea's elder sister.

customize.name: Forested Snowfield
customize.desc: While passing a lumberyard south of Morepesok, you unexpectedly ran into some Volkodlaks harassing the local workers... Looks like it's trouble stirred up by gang members again? Seems like it's time for you to step in.

customize.name: Tactical Maneuvers within the Shadow Realm
Shadow Realm Barrier & Shadow Realm Vault
Specialized Frag Crystals within the Shadow Realm

imgDesc.text: If the nation of Snezhnaya were envisioned as a titan of cold iron and steel, its sprawling railways would be its veins, and the Central Station of Snezhnograd undoubtedly serves as the titan's ever-pounding heart.

None can divine the thoughts of the sovereign who rules from that throne of sculpted ice.
From her high balcony, she stands in isolation from time to time, as if attempting to hold the plaza below and the entire world within her sight.

Word has it that the civilian rights to the Kresnik Kristall were granted by the Belyi Tsar himself.
To the people of Snezhnaya, he was both the biting frost of the blizzard and the dawn that brought them warmth.
Perhaps only real fools would attempt to overthrow the rule of the skies. But then, only fools possess the heart and courage to carry such a burden.

galleryCharacter.key: Where Dancers and Singers Weave Their Dreams

imgDesc.text:
In this theater, the relentless toil backstage is secondary to all else.
Whether one can grant the audience even a momentary escape into a beautiful illusion is the only true measure of success.

The relics of a long-lost civilization remain a source of prosperity to this day.
Here, countless craftsmen and excavators work around the clock, shaping the essential raw materials required to construct tomorrow's empire.

galleryCharacter.key: Where Warriors Sing the Sea Shanties

imgDesc.text: The homeland of warriors who master the raging seas. They chart courses into the dark abyss aboard simple fishing craft, never blinking an eye even before the gaze of mountain-sized sea monsters.

Perhaps she had already suffered far too much from the agony of "loss."
Perhaps, for one who faded away amidst hatred and madness, this was the gentlest end.
If the desperate wish to hold onto something burns too fiercely, perhaps even the lightning striking from the heavens above will freeze mid-air for its sake.
